verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no native, real-time, bidirectional ERP sync. The Card Expenses API, which lets you pull approved expenses and mark them synced, plus the Bills API and webhooks, are developer building blocks for constructing a mostly one-way integration, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can rely on real-time bidirectional sync with my ERP instead of manual journal entries
